CFG-01.name: points_per_agent_per_week
CFG-01.rationale: Standard baseline agent delivery velocity assuming 1 story point per agent-day with 5 active work days per week.
CFG-01.risk_if_wrong: Under-estimating velocity causes over-staffing; over-estimating velocity causes schedule slippage.

CFG-02.name: story_points_per_feature_ac
CFG-02.rationale: Mapping acceptance criteria density to Fibonacci story points per Handbook Chapter 5 and 6.
CFG-02.risk_if_wrong: Inaccurate seat count computation if acceptance criteria complexity departs from point scale.

CFG-03.name: role_merge_threshold_stories
CFG-03.rationale: Roles with under 2 stories are merged into neighbouring or fullstack role per Handbook 6.1.1 to avoid idle seats.
CFG-03.risk_if_wrong: Specialized tasks might require broader skillset in merged engineer.

CFG-04.name: idle_seat_threshold_weeks
CFG-04.rationale: No seat may sit idle for more than 1 week of its span per Handbook 6.2.5 Quality Bar.
CFG-04.risk_if_wrong: Unproductive seats inflating token and budget expenditure.

CFG-05.name: rework_buffer_multiplier
CFG-05.rationale: 20% rework buffer applied to stage token estimates per Handbook 5.1.6.
CFG-05.risk_if_wrong: Token overruns if rework exceeds 20% buffer.

CFG-06.name: agent_names_config_pool
CFG-06.rationale: Predefined config pool for deterministic agent names per Recruiter specification.
